text:
sam: flipped orbit-labs to v2-prefer for a 3% canary at 07:22 PT. dashboard shows a brief surge on v1 tokens even though traces show chosen_route=v2. anyone on telemetry/routing?

console-bot: note: change detected: tenant=orbit-labs v2_prefer=true @2025-01-14T14:22:10Z. charts aggregate by billing_meter_key by default.

anya: seeing the same. router traces: chosen_route=v2 for req ids, but billing logs show meter_key=v1 for ~90s after flip. looks like memoized meter-key not invalidated.

lee: confirm: billing service caches tenant->meter mapping for 5m to reduce DB load. canary flips cause mismatch until cache expires.

cecil: short mitigation: set tenant pin.ttl=0 for the canary and temporarily drop billing.memo_ttl to 20s for `orbit-*` tenants. who can change those?

sam: i can set pin.ttl=0 now. opsbot?

opsbot: prod-config-change: pin.ttl(orbit-labs)=0 applied by sam @2025-01-14T14:24:00Z.

lee: i'll push a small billing hotfix to lower memo_ttl for canary patterns and add a pubsub invalidation hook on `tenant-routing:update`. PR incoming.

anya: UX follow-up: we should show a small banner when toggling route flags: "Attribution may lag ~2m due to billing caching" and add a chart toggle "show by chosen route / show by billing key" so PMs don't misinterpret momentary spikes.

cecil: analytics idea: expose `last_billing_sync_age` per tenant and add suppression rule for quota alerts when sync_age > 60s and recent route-change within 5m.

sam: agreed. i'll create a short RFC capturing infra patch, toast copy, and runbook step (invalidate memo on flips). assigning: lee infra, anya UX, cecil analytics.

lee: PR #5770 opened: "billing: memo invalidation on tenant-routing:update". adds pubsub subscriber and test.

anya: sketch for toast: "Route update in progress — billing & quota metrics may lag up to 2 minutes. Dismiss". will attach mock.

sam: thanks all. metrics realigned ~90s after pin change + hotfix. closing once RFC posted. :white_check_mark:
